status: evidence ledger; not an executable recipe or physical-fit acceptance

parameterClasses.observed: Published measurement or inspected metadata, retaining stated uncertainty and coverage.
parameterClasses.published-model: Inference conditional on the cited study assumptions; not direct measured depth.
parameterClasses.authored: Our geometry/display choice, including extrapolation and coordinate conventions.

coordinateRule: Sky offsets are east/north relative to theta1-ori-c. Convert angular offsets through the registered tangent projection. Preserve each paper distance; physical-to-angular conversions use that recorded distance, not a hidden global rescaling.

sources.access: original scanned PDF retrieved; first page visually inspected

sources.locator: Sections I, II.6, III.1.2, III.2, III.3.1
Sections II, VIII.2, VIII.4, X.2; Figure 23

sources.access: seven complete FITS arrays and headers inspected
previous research intake; preserve competing model

evidence.limitations: Coordinate anchor only; not a measured gas-depth origin.

value.origin: registered observation frame; z=0 is an authored stellar reference

evidence.limitations: Paper offsets east/north from theta1 Ori C are converted to the registered west/north tangent frame. Positive depth is away from Earth. This is a coordinate convention, not measured gas depth.

evidence.scope: Publisher WCS; optical and VISTA have different coverage
evidence.limitations: Missing optical coverage is not zero emission. The common 104 arcminute square is a processing frame, not a measured object boundary.

evidence.scope: Central Huygens region; WCS/footprint in physical-sources.json
evidence.limitations: No quality-mask or uncertainty extensions. Some units and the Halpha-flux WCS are absent. These maps are not active fit constraints.

evidence.value: extinction-corrected Halpha + electron-density diagnostics + single-star illumination
evidence.limitations: Compares constant and declining density profiles. It does not measure depth from RGB intensity; later Orion-S geometry revises the earlier interpretation.
Approximate local reference scales; the thickness is an equivalent emitting layer, not a constant physical slab everywhere.

evidence.scope: Central EW strip; local structure below about 1 arcmin
evidence.limitations: Locally convex EW, approximately flat NS around a molecular filament; broader front can be concave. Axisymmetry does not hold globally.
No numeric ridge trace or inclination is imported. Any initial ridge coordinates, width and curvature remain authored.
Radius/wall vary about 50 percent with position angle. Not a closed sphere or the larger neutral Veil shell.
This is a spectral sample center and aperture, not the measured cloud center or dimensions.

value.depthRelation: in front of continuous MIF; near star depth

evidence.limitations: Exact depth uncertain. Projected diameter refers to a compact cloud estimate, not the larger Crossing aperture or all SW emission.
Approximate region-specific model; do not impose the thin-front thickness here or promote to a full-field slab.
An aperture is not an extinction mask or a measured dust-depth surface.

evidence.scope: Huygens + Extended Orion Nebula; distinct tracers/components
evidence.limitations: Competing interpretations; do not infer wall depth from expansion speeds or paint the optical photograph onto neutral foreground material.

evidence.value: smooth irregular support with finite local thickness; separate localized structures
evidence.scope: Covered image field, with physical support localized to core
evidence.limitations: Wide-field curvature, depth amplitudes, smoothing, local support weights and all unmeasured depths are authored. They must be pinned in the runnable recipe; no scalar RGB-to-depth or Helix expansion law.

implementationContract: A runnable support recipe must pin this ledger and classify every adopted numeric parameter. A citation never changes an authored amplitude into a measurement.
Keep front, cavity, Orion-S, molecular filament and foreground layer identities separate. Localize evidence by its actual footprint.
Smoothness may connect unsupported regions as an explicitly authored hypothesis; it is not a continuation of measured depth.
Do not convert barycentric/heliocentric/LSRK values without explicit frame handling. Do not turn velocity into spatial depth.
Do not treat extinction or reflected-light deficits as missing positive emission, or infer molecular mass from an outreach RGB lens.
Inspect neutral observer/oblique/side views and preserve the same geometry, alpha and stars for all image lenses.

inputRequirements: explicit support parameters with authored values distinguished
limitations: A smooth support is a conditional visualization hypothesis until compared with qualified physical observables.
The MUSE maps remain research inputs; their download does not mean the current solver fits them.
Do not infer the entire wide-field geometry from Huygens-only scales or apply a planetary expansion law.
